name: human-strength-functions
description: Hv1 Platform - Google Play Backend Verification & RTDN Functions

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.test: npm run build && mocha --reporter spec lib/test/index.test.js lib/test/identity.test.js lib/test/entitlement.contract.test.js
scripts.test:rules: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hv1-strength-local --only firestore "mocha --reporter spec lib/test/firestore.rules.test.js"
scripts.test:plan-draft: npm run build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-hv1-strength-local --only firestore "mocha --reporter spec lib/test/studio-plan-draft.test.js"
